Thanks for the details — I ran a quick sensitivity pass and attached an updated cost sheet. Summary of the material differences vs the draft:

- Cache hit assumptions: recalculated for 20%/35%/50% hit. At 20% hit, tokens/$ drops ~22% vs the 35% baseline.
- Batching: estimated p50 latency impact per batch size on the selected model (70b-int8):
  - batch=1: p50 110ms, p95 420ms
  - batch=2: p50 130ms (+20ms), p95 380ms
  - batch=3: p50 150ms (+40ms), p95 360ms
  - batch=4: p50 180ms (+70ms), p95 350ms
  - batch=5: p50 220ms (+110ms), p95 340ms

Recommendation for POC: start with batching=2 (compromise on p50/+20ms) and aggressive prefix normalization to push cache to 30% quickly. We'll instrument true prefix reuse in Week 1.

- Quantization: int8 gives best cost curve with modest quality tradeoffs; int4 is promising but needs an eval slice (we should reserve a small percentage of traffic for int4 blind comparisons).

Quick economics snapshot (rounded):
- Baseline (batch=3, cache=35%): ~13,200 tokens/$1
- Conservative (batch=2, cache=20%): ~10,300 tokens/$1
- Optimistic (batch=3, cache=50%): ~15,800 tokens/$1

1) Alex: share sample request logs (anonymized) — I will feed them into the model to produce a tailored cost curve.
2) Jonas/Rachel: confirm commercial guardrails for band A vs B so I can produce final dashboards.
3) Week 1: enable prefix hashing + batching=2 on test pool; collect 3 days of traffic.
